canonical_statement: For every group G, the left-regular permutation action identifies G with its image subgroup in the full permutation group on the underlying set of G.

canonical_formal_target.serialization: Statement.lean emits the target with pp.universes=true and pp.explicit=true. check_statement.py extracts the exact printed expression bytes and binds them to the expression and complete Lean-output SHA-256 values.

domain_and_universes: universe u; G : Type u; [Group G]; target Prop in universe 0; the permutation group and range subgroup are constructed on the same carrier G without finiteness or decidable-equality assumptions.
conclusion: Nonempty (G ≃* (MulAction.toPermHom G G).range), where the inferred Monoid.toMulAction is left multiplication and the codomain is the image subgroup in Equiv.Perm G.
minimal_import_basis: The first module supplies MulAction.toPermHom and permutation-group vocabulary; the second supplies MonoidHom.range and its Subgroup carrier. Deleting either direct import makes Statement.lean fail. The broader proof-bearing Mathlib.GroupTheory.Perm.Subgroup module is deliberately absent and Equiv.Perm.subgroupOfMulAction is checked unavailable.

checked_alternate_encodings.boundary: This is the catalog's literal existence of some permutation subgroup, using the same underlying carrier. Only the checked canonical-to-existential direction is credited.

uncredited_alternate_encodings: isomorphism to an existential subgroup of Equiv.Perm X for a separately quantified carrier X

regular_action_orientation: The inferred Monoid.toMulAction uses left multiplication, so MulAction.toPermHom sends g to the permutation x |-> g * x. No right-action, opposite-group, or inversion transport is credited.
